subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------ALT.F.
description: Diagram in WAM-27, paired with v1-p85-1 on the same page. (C)POL-DYM (political dynamics) is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism): if the previous diagram established that western methodology is politically constituted, this one stages the inverse — what alternative functionalism would have to confront to rework the political-dynamic regime. Besides the main line to ALT-F, POL-DYM branches two ways: into TRS (transition) → POL-P (political policies), which branches into PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and INFO-DY (information dynamics), with INFO-DY carrying (r)PART (the reality of participation) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism) → MT-INFO (multi-information); and into AFTF (affinity transfer), which branches into MTH (methodology) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). The structural claim: alternative functionalism's relation to political dynamics is *not* mediated by participation in the diagram — participation sits on a side branch under information dynamics, reached only through transition and political policies.
